obernants.operator: Order is read UTF-8, remove leading BOMs, locate START, locate END, check ordering, select heading/end, reject empty paragraphs, acquire annotator, encode/write. Earlier errors exclude later effects. Output write is not atomic; no rollback claim after acquisition. Oracle: sentinel unchanged on reversed markers.
